drop_confirmation: confirmed prior bilateral lift, total loss of grasp contacts, relative downward slip, then upward impact on registered ground support; regrasp cancels pending loss
unconfirmed_airborne_outcome: Confirmed grasp loss is a violation even without observed impact. Short unconfirmed loss remains UNKNOWN. Invalid raw recording remains UNKNOWN.
notes: Contact deadband is numerical event resolution. Load limits are calibrated per interface/phase, never supplied here. No hardware damage limit is claimed.
load_interface: object body + contact category + counterpart body + phase; opposing counterpart forces are never merged
jam_command_source: signed TCP displacement from actual applied arm position targets + FK; native OSC_POSE translation action uses its frozen 0.05 m scale; relative to insertion axis, never a stage/intent label
force_aggregation: sum of per-contact force magnitudes per interface; net resultant and world-XY magnitude sums reported separately; moments shifted to object origin before vector sum
grasp_loss_confirmation: Prior bilateral lift, no finger contact, outside qualified placement, downward relative separation > 0.035 m and world downward velocity < -0.05 m/s continuously for one complete control interval. Regrasp before confirmation cancels the candidate; confirmed loss remains a violation.
primary_drop_semantics: Unexpected sustained grasp loss OR legacy support-impact-confirmed drop; impact is a separately recorded outcome.
wipe_joint_proximity_scope: Wipe only: independently reconstruct native check_q_limits from recorded end-of-step qpos and model arm joint ranges. This is proximity to a native operating boundary, not proof of hard-range penetration.
wipe_primary_rule: Non-tool robot contact remains the only primary rule; joint_limit_proximity is a separately reported secondary event.
